query: What are the most innovative and high-quality trends in Humanities, Literature, and Arts related to investigating indexical grounding, "hall of mirrors" problems, and methodological approaches discussed?

response.query: What are the most innovative and high-quality trends in Humanities, Literature, and Arts related to investigating indexical grounding, hall of mirrors problems, and methodological approaches discussed?
response.answer: Innovative trends in Humanities focus on archiving and reinterpreting artworks as living documents, emphasizing indexical grounding and hall of mirrors problems through artist interviews and institutional practices. Methodological approaches include merging collections and archives to challenge traditional musealization. Current trends highlight the role of artist narratives in shaping understanding.

results.title: [PDF] Impure vision : American staged art photography of the 1970s - Lucris
results.content: In contrast to the painterly aesthetics of the pictorialists, who with their photographs manipulated to look like paintings had dominated the American art photography scene from the last decades of the nineteenth century, the straight photographers emphasized a tech-nique that involved unmanipulated silver prints of high contrast and sharp focus, an aversion to cropping, and an aesthetic attention to geometric, formal elements of the photographed objects.6 Te photographic ideal of visual purity in modernist, straight photography must be understood against the development of the photographic vision formed by the scientifc use of photography during the nineteenth century.
